title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 47 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 47)

content.overview: Section 47 prescribes the documentary requirements for enforcement of a foreign award in India, including the original award or duly authenticated copy, the original arbitration agreement or duly certified copy, and such evidence as may be necessary to establish that the award is a foreign award.
